parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the problems involved in preventing the spread of cholera.

text: Cholera bacteria release the enzyme neuraminidase which alters some of the surface
proteins on the membranes of epithelial cells in the small intestine.
These surface molecules become receptors for the toxin, choleragen, released by cholera
bacteria. The toxin stimulates the cells to secrete large quantities of chloride ions into the
lumen of the small intestine. Sodium ions and water follow the loss of chloride ions.
